Bloomberg reported yesterday that Apple has partnered with LG to develop several new smart home accessories, which will be launched under the LG brand. Leaked images have also revealed the appearance of a smart door lock, thermostat, and temperature sensor.

The images reveal three Home accessories that Apple allegedly developed for LG

Apple is reportedly set to launch a long-awaited major revamp of its Home products next week. The company will introduce an all-new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini, as well as a brand new product category that we have been referring to as the "HomePad."

However, Bloomberg's report yesterday revealed another part of Apple's Home product strategy. The company has partnered with LG to develop several new Home accessories, which will be sold under the LG brand.

According to reports, these accessories include a smart door lock, thermostat, temperature sensor, video doorbell, indoor camera, outdoor camera, and floodlight camera.

Today, leaker pdfu shared the first images of three of these products: a smart door lock, smart thermostat, and temperature sensor.

Popular comments from LateStage

LG, you mean that TV brand that was exposed for spying on users even when turned off? Where did Apple's commitment to privacy go?

pdfu's post on X also includes more details about these products.

For example, the smart deadbolt lock features a rotatable keypad for entry, with settings including a "touchpad light ring, door ajar sound alert, lock volume," and supports features such as auto-unlock.

Mark Gurman previously stated that these new products may not ship in time with Apple's new HomePod and Apple TV. Nevertheless, at next week's event, Apple still has a good chance of mentioning these products.

What do you think of these smart home accessories designed by Apple and made by LG? Let us know in the comments section.

Best Apple Home Accessories

  • eufy 4K camera with HomeKit Secure Video support
  • Aqara smart door lock with Apple Home Key and UWB
  • HomeKit garage door opener
  • HomeKit smart plug four-pack
  • Aqara smart thermostat with adaptive temperature feature
